openings.claim: Pattern-specific envelope quantities and post-insertion ticks may reduce memory-dependent omissions; exterior pattern marks may reduce assignment exchanges. Loose local staging challenges shared trays as necessary for accuracy.
openings.discriminator: Compare quantity cues against proximity. Matched local staging succeeding while marked shared-tray kits fail challenges memory as dominant; correctly ticked incomplete envelopes defeat insertion checking.
openings.probe: Two volunteers alternate three matched four-kit batches: incumbent trays, marked/ticked envelopes with trays, and local loose staging without quantity cues. Include preparation and audit within 18 minutes; tally crossings, omissions and time; audit against samples; stop if staging exceeds table space.
openings.uncertainty: Envelope legibility, staging footprint and cap feasibility are unverified. O4 mixture and omission stage are unknown; full-run throughput and distribution benefits remain untested.

openings.claim: Exact batch totals turn an omitted item into visible surplus, triggering reopening before stacking. Tags identify material; samples specify allocation; surplus localizes the batch, not the deficient envelope.
openings.discriminator: At equal proximity, exact totals should reveal seeded omissions unlike unrestricted stock. No surplus despite verified staging, or repeated unexplained surplus in intact batches, defeats the implemented signal.
openings.probe: Compare two matched local batches, exact totals versus ordinary stock, within five minutes and table limits. Both volunteers seed one omission per batch, record detection, staging time and false alarms, then restore contents before stacking; distribute no defective probe kits.
openings.uncertainty: Sample correctness, exact staging, batch separation and costs are unverified. Miscounts or displacement cause false alarms; omission/overfill cancellation means zero surplus proves neither allocation nor identity.

decision: Probe both; no improvement is established by synthetic stipulations. Preserve specified quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, total work within 90 minutes, existing 180-by-75-centimetre table and existing supplies without purchases. Success remains all 60 ready with at most one distribution correction; combined probing overhead and shortage handling remain unresolved.
